decisionsTitle: «Lista publică și clasamentul»: the public-list choice in a block of its own on the manage page and «Înscrierile mele» (amending §143's and §186's presentation, not their rule)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-20**, of the participant's own page and its public-list switch: «trebuie ca asta sa fie mai vizibila». The switch (§143) was a sentence and an outlined button lost among the page's other sections — under the race-day block, the declaration line and «Completează-ți datele»; on a family's page with no heading at all; on «Înscrierile mele» a small text button under the cancel. It is the one place a person controls a disclosure of their name (CLAUDE.md: a public participant list is a disclosure, not a display option), so it has to be found.

**Decision: a block of its own, for every registration** (`registrations/ui/PublicListChoice.tsx`, drawn on «Gestionează înscrierea» for every person on the page — a family's page included — and on «Înscrierile mele» for each registration). It changes how the choice is drawn, never its rule: the tick stays the person's own, off unless they gave it, written by the one function (`list-consent.ts#setListConsent`) with its audit row.

- **A box that stands out without alarming**: the info notices' tint (MUI `Alert` info's own background, through its CSS variable, so both colour schemes follow), the divider's border, the cards' corners — never an error or a warning colour: it is a choice, not a problem.
- **A heading on every registration**: «Lista publică și clasamentul» / “Public list and results” — `h2` on a one-person page, `h4` inside a family's person card, `h3` on «Înscrierile mele».
- **The state in bold beside the eye**, open when the name is shown, crossed when it is not. Off the list: «Numele tău nu apare pe lista publică a participanților și nici în clasament: pe listă apari ca „Participant (nume ascuns)”.» — the label read from the public list's own words (`Event.startList.anonymous`), never retyped. On the list: «Numele tău apare pe lista publică a participanților și în clasament.», but only where the published results would print the name: `domain/list-choice.ts#listChoiceState` asks the results' own rule, `publicResultName`, with the tick on and the registration confirmed and shown — a race, a privacy notice describing the results, the registration made under it or a later one, or asked since by «Vreau să apar cu numele în clasament» (§879). Elsewhere it says «Numele tău apare pe lista publică a participanților.», so the page never says «în clasament» while the results print «Participant #…» — the older notice's runner, whose own question is on the same page.
- **One button, the same in both states**: contained, the primary colour, large, at least 48 pixels tall and the full width of a phone, its eye the answer it gives, the words in sentence case — «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate» (the tick's own words, §570) or «Nu vreau să apar pe listă și în clasament». Withdrawing is exactly as easy and as visible as appearing (art. 7(3) GDPR): nothing pre-chosen, no colour that shames either answer, no wording that pushes. It is the house's `SubmitButton`, so a press says «Salvăm alegerea…» and is not sent twice.
- **One line under it**: «Poți schimba oricând, de aici sau din „Înscrierile mele”.»; on «Înscrierile mele» itself «Poți schimba oricând, de aici sau din pagina înscrierii.».

**Placed where the eye lands.** On the manage page right under the registration's state, number and QR with its «Sunt aici» line — before the declaration line, «Completează-ți datele», the offers, the results' question, the raffle, «Vii la …?» and the cancel; `#list` stays on the link's own person's block, where every press and the confirmation email's list link land. On «Înscrierile mele» under the QR and «Sunt aici», before the cancel and the offers.

**Nothing else changes**: the write and its audit row, the three doors and their actions, the confirmation email's own link and its page (`/inregistrari/lista/…`, its words kept), the results' older-notice question where it was (after the offers), every staff verb and every public page. The words `Registrations.list.choice.*` are new in both catalogues; `list.shortListed` and `list.shortNotListed`, which only the two pages read, are gone. The guide's two steps and «Sarcini»'s list-numbers row name the way out as the two pages now word it.

**Refused.** A red or amber box, or a coloured «Nu vreau» — it would shame one answer. A switch or a tick in place of the button: on these pages the press is the save, and a tick reads as a form still to send. «… și în clasament» on every listed registration — false for the older notice's runner and before any notice describes the results. Moving the block above the QR: on race day the code is what the person opens the page for.
changelogLine: - **The public-list choice stands out** — on «Gestionează înscrierea» (every person of a family's page too) and «Înscrierile mele», «Lista publică și clasamentul» is a tinted box of its own right under the QR: the state in bold beside the eye, «Participant (nume ascuns)» named when the name is off the list, and one full-width button that looks the same whichever way it goes. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a registration still registered, when «Gestionează înscrierea» renders it — alone or as one person of a family's page — or «Înscrierile mele» lists it, then its public-list choice is a block of its own headed «Lista publică și clasamentul» / “Public list and results” (`h2` alone, `h4` in a family's card, `h3` on «Înscrierile mele»), in the info notices' tint with the divider's border, right under the registration's state, number and QR with «Sunt aici» and before the declaration line, the offers and the cancel; the state is bold beside an open eye when listed and a crossed eye when not, and `#list` is on the manage link's own person's block only (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `registrations/family-screens.test.ts`.

Given that block, when the name is off the list, then it reads «Numele tău nu apare pe lista publică a participanților și nici în clasament: pe listă apari ca „Participant (nume ascuns)”.» / “Your name is not on the public list of participants or in the results: on the list you appear as “Participant (name hidden)”.”, the label read from the public list's own words; when on it, «Numele tău apare pe lista publică a participanților și în clasament.» only where `publicResultName` would print the name for the registration ticked and confirmed — a race, a privacy notice describing the results, the registration under it or a later one, or asked since by «Vreau să apar cu numele în clasament» — and «Numele tău apare pe lista publică a participanților.» otherwise (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `registrations/list-choice.test.ts`.

Given that block in either state, when it renders, then it carries one contained, primary, large submit button at least 48 pixels tall and the full width of a 320-pixel screen — «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate» off the list, «Nu vreau să apar pe listă și în clasament» on it (amending criterion 23 for the way out on these two pages only) — with the same classes and the same fill both ways; one press through the manage link or «Înscrierile mele» sets the answer, says «Am reținut alegerea ta.», writes the participant's audit row through its door and spends no link, and nothing overflows at 320 pixels (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: e2e `manage-list-choice.spec.ts`.

batchLine: the public-list choice in a block of its own on the manage page and «Înscrierile mele»
